SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. B. REGISTER
File No. D 6453
Section 2, Special Branch
REPORT
Date February 26, 1935.

Subject Communication dated February 15, 1935 from the Consul-General for
Brazil regarding persons in Shanghai deprived of Brazilian citizenship.
Made by D. I. Everest Forwarded by. [Signature]

Among the list of persons mentioned in the attached
communication as having been deprived of Brazilian citizen-
ship owing to their having obtained passports by making false
declarations, the following individuals are known to the
Municipal Police:-

1) Emmanuel B. Sosichner, Russian Jew, professional gambler
and associate of arms and drug smugglers. Resides in
No. 25 Young Allen Court.

2) Sam Sharmine, Russian, is recorded as being a member of
a gang of arms and opium smugglers. His present where-
abouts are unknown.

3) Dr. E.G. Lobzowsky, Polish Jew, Dental Surgeon, 39 Peking
Road, is reported to be dental surgeon to the Soviet
Consulate.

4) Harry Shutte, Russian Jew, is the son of Yakir Shutte,
professional gambler, who is at present serving a sentence
of twelve months' imprisonment in Amoy Road Gaol on a
charge of conducting public gambling. Harry Shutte is
reported to have left Shanghai for Brazil eighteen months
ago.

5) Dr. Robert Holper, M.D., Russian Jew, is mentioned in
File D.5172 as a suspected Soviet agent. Resides in
No. 13/1173 Bubbling Well Road. (See also 10210)

6) Alexander Samsonovitch is believed to be identical with
*Moses L. Samsonovitch, Russian Jew, arms and drug smuggler,
who was arrested in Hongkong in possession of morphia in
January, 1925. (See also 10.626, 10.7201, 10.7466)

D. I. E.
Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch) 4/3.
[Signature]
4 MAR 1935

特别支部登记簿
档案号 D 6453
第二科，特别支部
报告
日期：1935年2月26日。

事由：巴西驻沪总领事于1935年2月15日来函，关于在上海被剥夺巴西国籍的人员。
呈报人：D. I. Everest 转呈人：[签名]

在附函所列因通过虚假声明获取护照而被剥夺巴西国籍的人员名单中，以下人员为工部局警务处所知悉：-

1) Emmanuel B. Sosichner，俄籍犹太人，职业赌徒，与军火及毒品走私者有勾结。居住于杨格艾伦里（Young Allen Court）25号。

2) Sam Sharmine，俄国人，记录显示其为军火及鸦片走私团伙成员。目前下落不明。

3) E.G. Lobzowsky 博士，波兰籍犹太人，牙科医师，北京路39号，据报担任苏联领事馆牙科医师。

4) Harry Shutte，俄籍犹太人，系 Yakir Shutte 之子。Yakir Shutte 为职业赌徒，目前因经营公开赌博罪在爱麦根路监狱（Amoy Road Gaol）服刑十二个月。据报 Harry Shutte 已于十八个月前离开上海前往巴西。

5) Robert Holper 博士，医学博士，俄籍犹太人，在档案 D.5172 中被提及为疑似苏联特工。居住于静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）13/1173号。（另见 10210）

6) Alexander Samsonovitch 被认为与 *Moses L. Samsonovitch 为同一人，后者为俄籍犹太人，军火及毒品走私者，曾于1925年1月在香港因持有吗啡被捕。（另见 10.626, 10.7201, 10.7466）

D. I. E.
副总监（特别支部） 4/3.
[签名]
1935年3月4日
